name: card-rail
title: Card rail
description: Portrait cards sit on a tilted plane and are flicked along it in two throws, each with a label.

props.name: images
props.doc: Pictures, as paths under public/ (or full URLs). They repeat when there are fewer than the count.

props.name: labels
props.doc: A name for each card, in order. Cards past the end of the list use the picture's own name.

props.name: count
props.doc: How many cards are on the rail.

props.name: cardWidth
props.doc: Width of a card, in px on the plane.

props.name: cardHeight
props.doc: Height of a card, in px on the plane.

props.name: gap
props.doc: Space between cards, in px.

props.name: tiltX
props.doc: How far the plane leans back, in degrees.

props.name: roll
props.doc: How far the plane is turned in its own plane, in degrees, so the rail runs on a diagonal.

props.name: perspective
props.doc: Camera perspective distance, in px. Lower is more dramatic.

props.name: flicks
props.doc: Each flick of the rail.

props.name: startZoom
props.doc: Zoom of the opening shot on the first card.

props.name: endZoom
props.doc: Zoom of the closing push on the centred card.

props.name: motionBlur
props.doc: Camera motion blur shutter in frames, used while the rail or camera moves fast. 0 turns it off.

props.name: lift
props.doc: How far the centred card rises off the plane, in px.

props.name: title
props.doc: Title at the top left. Empty for none.

props.name: caption
props.doc: Smaller line under the title. Empty for none.

props.name: font
props.doc: Google Fonts family for the label and card numbers.

props.name: serif
props.doc: Google Fonts family for the card names (set in italic).

props.name: colors.ground
props.doc: Background.

props.name: colors.ink
props.doc: Title.

props.name: colors.muted
props.doc: Caption.

props.name: colors.card
props.doc: Card colour behind the picture.

props.name: colors.cardText
props.doc: Card names.
